description: Shared definition for a user-defined field that can be attached to entities.

members.name: Options
members.description: Predefined option values for list, multiselect, and label fields.

members.name: IsRequired
members.description: Whether consumers should require a value before saving.

members.name: AppliesToEntityTypes
members.description: Entity types this field applies to. Empty means all entity types.

members.name: AppliesTo
members.description: Returns true when the definition applies to the provided entity type.
